verdict.rationale: vLLM's PagedAttention, KV cache management, and gpu_memory_utilization-style controls (implied by docs on efficient attention memory management, continuous batching, and parallelism options) let power-users influence memory allocation, and community evidence confirms KV cache/continuous batching are central design strengths. However, there's no explicit evidence of fine-grained per-instance memory allocation controls for concurrent multi-model serving, so this is inferred rather than directly documented.
